part.text:
Fixed the duplicate logging/middleware issue in `routergroup.go:208`.

The static handler was resetting the chain to `allNoRoute`, which includes global middleware that had already run. Using `noRoute` runs only the 404 handlers, so middleware executes once per request.

Verified: `go test ./...` passes, including `TestMiddlewareCalledOnceByRouterStaticFSNotFound`.
